prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find, move, and grab object. If heavy, move to destination. Finally, do specific task. Scan for new object.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = FindObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Conditional ID = IsObjectGrabbable    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Sequence>     <Conditional ID = IsObjectHeavy    />     <Action ID = MoveObjectToDestination    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForNewObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
		DO FindObject
		DO MoveToObject
			IF IsObjectGrabbable? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	END
